value.name: lake_boehmer
value.composition_note: TDS about 105 g/L (three times seawater; derived estimate, needs_verification against the sealed MPGCD Sloan Blair No. 1 laboratory report); sulfate about 7,500 mg/L; hydrogen sulfide design value 110 ppm at the wellhead (worst reported case; the MPGCD laboratory read far higher); slight radioactivity and arsenic reported, unquantified (gap). Artesian brine from the abandoned well, not irrigation drainage.
value.treatment: degas, lime/soda softening, two-stage electrodialysis (the LB train); product and concentrate both return to the lake (Q-037)
value.verification_test: sealed MPGCD laboratory report on the wellhead brine; the full ionic assay replaces every derived value (A-M-434/435/436)
